item.title: Aquatic Center closed for swim meet, holiday
item.description: The McMinnville Aquatic Center will be closed Friday through Monday for a swim meet and observance of Presidents’ Day. The facility will host the Pacific Conference district meet on Feb. 13-14, is closed Sundays and will remain closed for the holiday Monday, according to city staff.

item.title: Lawmakers reveal reworked plan to partially delay campaign
item.description: Oregon lawmakers forced by the threat of a citizen-led ballot measure to adopt a sweeping law limiting campaign contributions in 2024 are once again trying to delay key portions of the law before it takes effect.

item.title: Grange hosts Valentine's dances
item.description: The McMinnville Grange will host Valentine’s dances and parties Friday and Sunday, Feb. 13 and 15. Third Fret will perform live country music from 7:30 to 10:30 p.m. Friday in the Grange hall, 1700 S.W. Old Sheridan Road, McMinnville. A potluck will start at 9 p.m. Mill Creek Road Band will play from 1 to 4 p.m. Sunday. A potluck will start at 2:30 p.m. Cost for each event is $7 for Grange members and $10 for non-members.

item.title: Health care job fair planned
item.description: People interested in health care professions can attend a job fair from noon to 2 p.m. Wednesday, Feb. 18, at the WorkSource Oregon Yamhill Center, 370 N.E. Norton Lane, McMinnville. Admission is free. Employers set to be at the fair include Willamette Valley Medical Center, Life Care Center of McMinnville, Frontier Senior Living, Home Instead, Friendsview, Willow Place and Visiting Angels.
